facts.content: The assessment is persistent severe headache with photophobia and visual disturbances, with possible migraine and urgent neurological assessment warranted to exclude secondary causes.
facts.source_text: Persistent severe headache with photophobia and visual disturbances, possible migraine:  The patient presents with a new severe headache ongoing for three days, associated with photophobia and unusual visual symptoms. History and examination pending but migraine appears likely given family history and symptomatology. Other causes not documented; urgent neurological assessment warranted to exclude secondary causes.
